name: Y9a

Battery.Charging: Y9a: fast charging at 22.5 W (4200 mAh), fast charging at 40 W (4300 mAh), Enjoy 20 Plus: fast charging at 40 W

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, 3.5 mm Audio, Bluetooth 5.1 (A2DP, LE), Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, Beidou
